title: release-qualify --from-distill admits the GMCP evidence re-record the release branch must make
goal: A distilled candidate whose tasks change GMCP evidence inputs can be promoted: after the envelope, the release tree may carry the version bump and a re-record of .agents/gmcp/evidence/*.jsonl, which the block lists and the tag check proves

results.why: v0.21.56 (board item 167) had to leave out T-CORECUT-1..3, T-TRUTHDOCS-1, T-AGYCLOUD-1/2/3 and others: their candidates need the GMCP evidence re-recorded on the release branch (docs/release-distillation.md), and --from-distill allowed only the version bump after the envelope
results.change: verify_bump_only also admits A/M/D of *.jsonl directly in .agents/gmcp/evidence/ and returns those paths; the distillation block lists them as gmcp_evidence_rerecorded only when non-empty, so the v0.21.56 block is unchanged; the tests gate's gmcp_requirements still fails on stale or foreign evidence
results.tests: distilled_release_promotion 9/9 (new a_gmcp_evidence_rerecord_after_the_candidate_is_admitted_and_named fails with the evidence arm disabled: 8 passed 1 failed); push-policy on the real refs/tags/v0.21.56 exit 0; cargo test -p xtask 29 binaries 606 passed 1 failed (ci_workflow_perf::no_gate_or_hook_depends_on_the_retired_target_guard, failing on origin/main since 192b53d27, unrelated); release_records 5, architecture 44, orphan 3, lean 2, core_docs 5, no_github 5, task_records 3; fmt; workspace clippy -D warnings

limitations: evidence files must sit directly in .agents/gmcp/evidence/ and end in .jsonl; the README and subdirectories stay refused
the evidence's correctness is proven by the tests gate, not by release-qualify's pre-gate check
